title: (Lack of) Innovation in Aviation
summary: Modern and intuitive avionics. Our hardware and software are designed from the ground up using state-of-the-art UI/UX technology to create beautiful and safe avionics
body_text: The most recent two major innovations in the small aircraft market came from Cirrus in the early 2000s: the glass cockpit and airframe parachute. Neither were new technologies, just an application of existing technologies into small piston aircraft for a typical individual. Interestingly, the market research at the time showed Cirrus that these innovations were not needed—the market didn’t want them. Cirrus pursued them anyway, and they won. Not because they were lucky, but because they did what was necessary for the market: innovate to improve product safety and overall quality. Other manufacturers followed suit. However, these new products came with a steep price increase. ‍ Fast-forward to 2020. There are over 19,000 airports in the United States, 5000 of them are open for public use. One could fly virtually anywhere and even fly within congested metropolitan areas such as Los Angeles, yet most prefer to road trip. The new generations do not want to learn to fly a clunky old machine. Most aspiring pilots grew up in the video game, computer, and internet era. They expect computers to do mundane tasks for them. Similar to how the automatic transmission unlocked a new wave of drivers by automating away what was considered a necessary skill, airplanes must get their own automation to bring in a new wave of pilots. ‍ At Airhart, we recognized this necessity when we first began learning how to fly. Nikita learned in a Cirrus SR20 with a glass cockpit and Brendan in the classic 172 on the six pack. Despite having a bunch of “modern” features in the Cirrus, the two planes flew the same. It required the same level of coordination and “stick and rudder mastery” to fly. It felt like how driving a car would feel if it required steering each wheel separately. As engineers, we knew this was a solvable problem and the solution we were thinking of was not a new one. The F22 flew not by commanding control surfaces, but by commanding flight direction and intent. ‍ An aerodynamically unstable fighter jet was easier to fly than a 172 trainer. This did not sit right with us. ‍ We made ourselves a promise .

Now comes the myriad of styling products. Section by section, you slop on a sticky leave-in conditioner, mousse and/or cream, perhaps topped off with a serum or spray—all in the name of a wash-and-go routine. But what about layering on four or five products says “wash and go,” anyway? In the end, you’re left with a bathroom cabinet that looks like a beauty supply store, a whooole lot of time and money spent and…well, that’s it. Rarely does this more-is-more approach actually give you the curls that we want. That’s because what you need is an easy curly hair routine. That’s us LUS (Love Ur Self)! 😁 Since our launch, we’ve refused to accept that curly hair has to be complicated. We knew there had to be an easier way, but since we couldn’t find the perfect formulas for a truly easy curly hair routine that also delivered on results, we created it. And that’s how LUS (Love Ur Self) was born. 🙌 The foundation of our brand is our easy 3-Step System, which takes the guesswork out of maintaining beautiful and healthy curls, saving you both time, money and energy. Shop 3-Step System Steps 1 & 2: Shampoo and Conditioner Our shampoo and conditioner make up the first two steps of our beloved 3-Step System. There’s an old (but persistent) myth in the curly hair community that it doesn’t actually matter which products you use in the shower, and that styling products are the only place that good formulas count. Selecting good-for-you shampoos and conditioners that are specifically formulated with curly hair in mind, is crucial for achieving soft, bouncy and defined curls. Our shampoo is formulated to be gentle on your hair, something that’s extremely important for curls. It's free of sulfates and harsh detergents to ensure that while your scalp and hair are being cleansed of excess oil, debris and build-up, your hair isn't being stripped of its much-needed natural oils and moisture. Then, our ultra-rich, silicone-free conditioner slides through your hair like butter, binding moisture into your hair and leaving it soft and hydrated. It’s infused with shea butter and moringa oil to repair dry, damaged hair, and is totally colour-safe and suitable for all curl types. Together, these two steps ensure your hair is primed and ready for styling. Shop Shampoo Shop Conditioner Step 3: All-In-One Styler Here comes the really easy part of your new easy curly hair routine.
